description_en: Updates the information of a digital human training task. This operation allows you to: 1. Modify basic information. 2. Update parameters such as Video and Transparent to retrain the digital human after a training failure
description_zh:
调用此接口能够修改数字人训练任务的信息，包括：
修改基本信息；
在训练失败后，更新 Video、Transparent 等信息后重新进行训练
name: UpdateAvatarTrainingJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the digital human training task
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.example: The name of the digital human.
parameters.help_en: The name of the digital human. The name can be up to 7 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数字人名称，不多于 7 个字符
parameters.name: avatar_name

parameters.example: This is a digital human, intended for use in a certain scenario.
parameters.help_en: The description of the digital human. The description can be up to 1,000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数字人描述。不多于 1000 个字符
parameters.name: avatar_description

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the thumbnail.
The thumbnail is uploaded to this URL after the training succeeds.
The URL must be a valid public Object Storage Service (OSS) URL within your account.
The URL can be up to 512 characters in length.
The URL cannot be updated after the training succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
缩略图 URL
训练成功后会将缩略图上传到本地址中
必须是用户下合法的 OSS 公网 URL
不多于 512 个字符
训练成功后不允许更新
parameters.name: thumbnail

parameters.help_en: The media asset ID of the profile picture. The ID must be 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 头像图片媒资 ID，长度为 32 个字符
parameters.name: portrait

parameters.help_en:
The media asset ID of the training video.
The ID must be 32 characters in length.
The MP4, MOV, and WebM formats are supported.
The video duration must be between 5 and 15 minutes.
The video resolution must be 1920 × 1080 or 1080 × 1920
parameters.help_zh:
训练视频媒资 ID
长度为 32 个字符
支持 mp4，mov，webm 格式
素材时长需在 5 分钟到 15 分钟内
素材分辨率需为 1920 * 1080 或 1080 * 1920
parameters.name: video

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the uploaded video supports a transparent channel.

You can modify this parameter only for tasks in the Initialized or Training Failed state.
<notice>Make sure that this setting matches the properties of the submitted training video. Otherwise, the synthesized digital human may behave abnormally.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
用于标识传入的视频是否支持透明通道。

仅允许处于「初始化」或「训练失败」状态下的任务修改本字段
<notice>请严格确认当前设置与提交训练视频情况一致，否则合成数字人可能会异常></notice>
parameters.name: transparent

JobId.description_en: The ID of the digital human training task

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功：
true：调用成功
false：调用失败
